seoTitle: Wichita Public Schools Calendar 2027–28: Dates & PDFs
seoDescription: Wichita Public Schools starts Aug. 12, 2027, and ends May 24, 2028. See WPS breaks, no-school days, conferences, grading periods, and official calendar PDFs.
heroSummary: Wichita Public Schools starts classes Thursday, August 12, 2027, and the last day of school is Wednesday, May 24, 2028. Fall Recess runs November 23–26, Student Winter Recess runs December 17–January 4, and Spring Recess runs March 13–17. Students in grades 6–12 who are new to their building attend orientation on August 11.
heroSourceLine: Based on the official WPS 2027–28 School Year Calendar, approved February 2 and revised February 5, 2026

calendarNotes: WPS lists August 12 as the first student day and May 24 as the last. Student Winter Recess runs December 17–January 4; the shorter December 24–January 3 range shows when district administrative offices are closed. January 4 is a District Inservice Day, and the calendar expressly lists January 5 as the student return date. WPS standardizes parent-teacher conference dates districtwide and separately identifies the conference day with no school, the next nonteaching day, and later Conference Release Days. The PDF lists 171 contact days across four grading periods. Kindergarten opening attendance is assigned by each school and is not represented as a separate districtwide date here.

The grading-period summary ends the student contact-day ranges on October 13, March 8, and May 24, while the event list separately marks October 15, March 10, and May 25 as the ends of those grading periods alongside nonteaching days. The table above follows the published contact-day ranges.

customSections.label: What Changes from WPS 2026–27 to 2027–28?
customSections.content:
The 2027–28 school year starts one day earlier on the calendar and ends one day earlier than 2026–27. Student Winter Recess begins four days earlier, while Spring Recess shifts two days earlier in March.

WPS also carried forward the November schedule changes introduced in 2026–27. Election Day remains a District Inservice Day, and the Veterans Day observance falls within Fall Recess week. WPS says this structure makes more schools available as polling sites, supports civic engagement, and gives students a full Fall Recess week.

customSections.label: Two Winter Recess Ranges Appear on the WPS Calendar
customSections.content: For student attendance, use the longer Student Winter Recess: December 17 through January 4. The shorter December 24–January 3 range shows when district administrative offices are closed. January 4 is also a District Inservice Day, and students return Wednesday, January 5.

rows: Students return to class after winter recess and the Jan. 4 inservice day

customSections.label: How WPS Conference Dates Affect Attendance
customSections.content: WPS sets parent-teacher conference dates districtwide. The calendar distinguishes the conference window from the no-school conference day, the following Nonteaching Duty Day, and later Conference Release Days. Schools set individual appointment times.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Wichita Public Schools students return after Winter Recess?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Wednesday, January 5, 2028. Student Winter Recess runs through January 4, and January 4 is also a District Inservice Day.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does the WPS calendar show two Winter Recess ranges?
calendarFaqs.a: December 17–January 4 is Student Winter Recess. The shorter December 24–January 3 range shows when district administrative offices are closed.

calendarFaqs.q: When are WPS parent-teacher conferences in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The districtwide conference ranges are October 12–14, 2027, and March 7–9, 2028. Students have no school on October 14 and March 9; schools provide appointment times.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a WPS Conference Release Day?
calendarFaqs.a: WPS explains that a Conference Release Day recognizes evening hours worked during parent-teacher conferences. Students do not attend on the published release day.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all Wichita kindergarten students attend school on August 12?
calendarFaqs.a: August 12 is WPS's districtwide first day of school, but kindergarteners have scheduled attendance days during the first few days. Families should follow the schedule provided by their school.

calendarFaqs.q: Are the Spanish and Vietnamese calendars different schedules?
calendarFaqs.a: No. They are official language versions of the same WPS 2027–28 school-year calendar and are linked in Downloads.
